integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connections to the systems that already hold the household's things.
integrations.ownersOnly: Only an owner or an admin can see and change integrations.
integrations.providerHint: Paperless-ngx and Nextcloud can sync; CalDAV can be configured but not yet read.
integrations.displayNameLabel: What should it be called here?
integrations.baseUrlHint: The full http:// or https:// address, on the household's own network.
integrations.tokenHint: For Nextcloud, create an app password rather than using the account password. Stored encrypted, never shown again, never written to a log.
integrations.keyringMissing: Set CREDENTIAL_KEYS and CREDENTIAL_ACTIVE_KEY before connecting a system. Until then a token cannot be stored safely, so connecting is disabled.
integrations.replaceTokenHint: Use this if the token has changed or you think it has leaked. Nothing else is altered.
integrations.newTokenHint: Sealed under the current encryption key.
integrations.errorConflict: This was changed by someone else. Reload and try again.
integrations.errorNotAuthorized: Only an owner or admin may do that.
integrations.errorInvalidInput: Check the details and try again.
integrations.errorKeyringUnavailable: No encryption key is configured, so a token cannot be stored safely.
integrations.errorNoAdapter: There is no adapter for that system yet.
integrations.errorNoCredential: This integration has no stored token.
integrations.scheduleExplainer: When this is set, the app contacts the system on its own, without anybody asking. A failed sync is retried a few times with a growing gap, then left alone with its error.
integrations.scheduleHint: Fifteen minutes is the shortest, so the household is not hammering its own server.
integrations.errorAlreadyRunning: This integration is already syncing. Wait for it to finish.
integrations.errorIntervalInvalid: Choose one of the offered intervals.
integrations.scheduleSummaryDaily: Syncs by itself once a day
integrations.usernameHint: The account the app password belongs to. Leave empty for Paperless.
integrations.remotePathHint: One folder, not the whole drive. Its subfolders are left alone. Empty means the account root.
integrations.errorNoAccount: Nextcloud needs the account the app password belongs to.
integrations.tokenNotKept: The token was not kept when the form came back. Paste it again.

export.title: Take your data out
export.description: Everything you can see in this app, in one file you can read without it.
export.countsCaption: Counted now, from the same records the download will contain.
export.nothingToExport: There is nothing here to export yet.
export.plainTextWarning: The file is not encrypted. It is your records in readable text, so keep it where you would keep the paperwork it came from.
export.scopeNote: It contains what you are permitted to see, which is not necessarily everything the household has.
export.notABackup: An export is a copy you can read anywhere. Restoring the app itself needs the database, which the household backs up separately.
export.backupLink: What the household needs to back up

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.description: What this app knows, and what the household has to do itself.
backup.ownersOnly: Only an owner or an admin can see this.
backup.notOursTitle: This app does not take the backups
backup.notOurs: Backups live where the rest of the homelab keeps them. Nothing here can tell you whether last night's ran, and a page that claimed otherwise would be worse than one that does not.
backup.yoursTitle: What has to be backed up
backup.layerDatabase: The PostgreSQL database — a logical dump is enough for everything the app stores.
backup.layerVolume: Any data volume the deployment adds later.
backup.layerConfig: The configuration, including AUTH_SECRET: without it every session breaks on restore.
backup.layerExport: Optionally an export file, as the copy that survives this app being gone.
backup.keysWarning: CREDENTIAL_KEYS must be kept somewhere the database backup is not. Stored together, a stolen dump comes with the keys to the integration tokens inside it, and the encryption protects nothing.
backup.keyringConfigured: An encryption key is configured on this instance.
backup.keyringMissing: No encryption key is configured, so no integration credentials can be stored yet.
backup.verifyTitle: Numbers to check a restore against
backup.verifyIntro: Note these before a restore. Afterwards they are what turns “it seems to have worked” into a check.
backup.drillIntro: Quarterly during active development, and before any major change.
backup.drill5: Compare these counts, and open a few records you recognise.
backup.drill6: Write down how long it took and whether it worked.
